appearance_facts.fact: Chart title reads 'Monthly Air Quality Alert Count'.
Y-axis is labeled 'Alert Days' with tick marks at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500.
X-axis is labeled 'Month' with three categories: January, February, and March.
A horizontal dashed line labeled 'Average' is drawn across the chart at a level slightly above the 400 mark, approximately at 440.
The January bar is the tallest of the three, reaching the same level as the 'Average' dashed line (approximately 440).
The February bar is shorter than January, reaching just below the 400 mark (approximately 380).
The March bar is the shortest, reaching approximately 260.
The top of the January bar aligns exactly with the 'Average' reference line, placing it at the average level rather than above or below it.

printed_facts.fact: Text label 'Average' is positioned to the right of the dashed line.
